data.gender_notes: Rauoof is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root word 'Rafa'a' which means 'to raise' or 'to exalt'. The name Rauoof signifies a person who is exalted or elevated in status and power. It is a name that is full of pride and dignity. The name Rauoof carries the meaning “Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Rauoof usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name carries a deep spiritual significance as it represents the presence of Allah (SWT) in a person's life. The name Rauoof is a reminder of the blessings and favors of Allah and inspires a person to strive towards greatness and righteousness.
data.etymology: Rauoof belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rauoof total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: رؤوف

in_arabic.long_meaning: رؤوف: اسم الله عزوجل، يعني رحيم و نرم دل و مہربان، جو اپنی بندوں پر مہربانی کرتا ہے اور ان کی خفیہ مدد کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفت ہے جو قرآن مجید میں مذکور ہے۔

in_urdu.name: رؤوف
